subject.title: feat(codex): instrument dynamic-tool bridge phase timing

question: Should Codex dynamic-tool bridge timing be emitted as an info-level record for every successful response, or be limited to the repository’s existing diagnostic/on-demand logging policy?
rationale: The patch establishes a new durable observability behavior on a hot runtime path; code review alone cannot choose the acceptable production logging volume and operator-facing semantics.

options.title: Use diagnostic/on-demand logging
options.body: Keep the phase propagation but route the derived record through the existing diagnostic policy so routine dynamic-tool traffic does not create permanent info-log volume.

options.title: Accept per-call info logs
options.body: Land the current info-level record as an intentional operational signal and document the expected volume and retention impact.

recommendation.title: Use diagnostic/on-demand logging
recommendation.body: Keep the phase propagation but route the derived record through the existing diagnostic policy so routine dynamic-tool traffic does not create permanent info-log volume.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server ownership history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the runtime logging policy.
